name: Adaptive Ascend
tagline: A space shooter that studies how you play and adapts enemies, a boss fight and help to you.
problem: Games rarely learn a player's weaknesses and adjust to them.
solution: Tracks accuracy, reaction time and damage to tune enemies between levels; a final boss uses three AI strategies; webcam hand gestures control shield and shooting; struggling players get features turned on through analytics flags.
demo_moment: Team-described: play with hand gestures and watch the next level change to target your weaknesses.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Amplitute: Build Self-Improving Products” among 160 submissions.
Uses product analytics as the adaptation engine, matching the sponsor's 'self-improving products' brief.
A solo builder hit a sponsor brief closely.

lessons: Answer the sponsor's brief literally, with their tool doing the core job.
